method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (hcsc-core.l4) with five regulative rules (the complaint within 2 years, s 27(1); the Commissioner's requirement within the period specified, s 28; the determination within 45 days, s 29(1); written notice within 14 days, s 29(6); the conciliation agreement in writing within 14 days, s 42(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside functions that take only plain facts; one seat layer (the person complaining) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, dates or paragraph references, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Health and Community Services Complaints Act 2004 (SA), the register's current version 4.12.2025 (the version the Current Titles list of 22 September 2026 gave), as the unauthorised RTF fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 and deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/health-and-community-services-complaints-act-2004.txt; with the Health and Community Services Complaints Regulations 2019, version 18.3.2019, deposited at subjects/au/sa/health-and-community-services-complaints-regulations-2019/registers/source-bundle/ (regs 4, 7 and 8 used). Not the authorised PDFs.

seat: the person complaining: the consumer of a health or community service (patient, client, resident, child), or the person complaining for them (parent, attorney, substitute decision-maker, family member or executor after a death) (hcsc-seat.l4)
focus: the complaints route to the Health and Community Services Complaints Commissioner, an out-of-court equivalent of the medical negligence and records-access claims not named in the claims list

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run hcsc-dates.l4 ; l4 run hcsc-core.l4 ; l4 run hcsc-seat.l4 ; l4 run hcsc-cases.l4
checks.result: 149 assertions written, 149 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control on a scratch copy (the s 29(6) window 14 to 13 days, the s 42(2) window 14 to 15 days) failed exactly the 3 predicted assertions
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
